page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is a storage-dense cloud server instance running on KVM hypervisor architecture. It features 32 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz, alongside 128.0 GB of memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

The primary feature of the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is its bundled local storage array totaling 94489 GB of hard disk drive (HDD) capacity. Network throughput is backed by a baseline networking speed of 20 Gbps. The reliance on mechanical HDDs rather than solid-state drives offers high capacity at a favorable storage density ratio, though random read and write access rates remain lower compared to NVMe storage instances.

This hardware configuration is suited for data-intensive processing that requires significant localized capacity, such as Apache Hadoop, log analytics pipelines, massive data warehousing, and large file archival systems.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is a storage-dense cloud server instance optimized for big data processing and high-capacity data retention. Built on x86_64 architecture and managed via KVM hypervisor, it provides 32 dedicated vCPUs from Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors running at 2.5 GHz, alongside 128.0 GB of RAM (4.0 GB per vCPU). The instance stands out with its direct-attached 94489 GB local HDD storage array and a 20 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The substantial spinning disk capacity yields high volumetric density per compute node, offering a cost-effective platform for workloads requiring massive disk volume over ultra-low latency IOPS. Lacking GPU acceleration, the hardware profile is tailored for large-scale distributed logging, Hadoop clusters, data warehousing, and batch processing where local storage capacity is the primary operational requirement.
